description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores of different MADLLM configurations across various datasets. The vertical axis represents the F1 score percentage, ranging from 60% to 100%. The horizontal axis lists the datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The bars are color-coded to represent different configurations: green for MADLLM, blue for MADLLM w/o prompt pool, purple for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and brown for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. The MADLLM configuration generally shows higher F1 scores across most datasets, with the highest score observed in the PSM dataset. The MADLLM w/o feature embedding configuration tends to have the lowest F1 scores, particularly in the WADI dataset. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on certain bars.
